text:
Hana: VelaMed just sent acceptance criteria. They want a POC perf run next Tue: mixed load (70% chat gen, 30% embeddings), target sustained 140 rps, p95 < 300ms, p99 < 650ms. Also asked for a ballpark monthly cost for ~50M tokens and confirmation we support customer-managed KMS. Can we run this on Dedicated?

Marco: Yep. I'll request infra. @Devin can you own the runbook + load plan? Also include a short security blurb for CMK.

Devin: I can take. Quick plan: warmup 10m to prime KV cache (short prefixes), then stepped ramp 35 -> 70 -> 105 -> 140 with 12m at each step, then a 20m soak at target. Capture p50/p95/p99, error rate, tokens consumed, and GPU telemetry. We'll run fp16 then repeat key steps in int8 to measure throughput delta. Abort criteria: p99 > 900ms or error rate > 1.5% or GPU mem > 90%.

Devin: Repro (example using wrk2 + lua):
```bash
# payload.json contains mixed generate/embed logic
wrk -t8 -c200 -d12m -s ./scripts/wrk_post_mix.lua -- "https://redwood.example/v1/generate" > run_35.log
# repeat with adjusted client-side pacing for 70/105/140
# soak: wrk --rate to hold 140rps for 20m
```
I'll also include a short script to inject every 3rd request as an embed to match the 70/30 mix.

Hana: Ops, please allocate a dedicated-2 (3x GPU slices) for 2026-04-20 15:00 UTC for a 3h window. We may scale down if int8 shows good tail.

ops-bot: Allocation confirmed: dedicated-medium (3x GPU) 2026-04-20T15:00:00Z duration 3h id alloc-5d2f.

Marco: Pricing ask: quick back-of-envelope for 50M tokens. Hosted retail ~ $0.0007/token -> ~$35k/mo. Dedicated amortized (3x GPU) incl infra + ops at ~70% util -> ~$30k-36k/mo. 2x GPU slice ~ $20k-24k/mo. Devin, can you add assumptions (avg tokens per gen/embed, utilization) to the runbook?

Devin: Yesassumptions I'll include: avg tokens/gen=120, avg tokens/embed=14, mix 70/30, util scenarios 50/70/90%, and quantization uplift. I'll add a small table with per-M token cost for each scenario and note that embeddings lower avg tokens per call.

Hana: Security blurb for customer: Dedicated & Private support CMK via our KMS integration; HSM-backed keys available for Private installs. We support SOC2 Type II and can provide redacted evidence via secure share. Marco please attach that appendix.

Marco: Will do. Runbook checklist: 1) prewarm 10m, 2) stepped ramp 48m, 3) soak 20m, 4) capture wrk logs + prom snapshots + GPU telemetry, 5) abort criteria as above, 6) post-run cost calc and short exec summary.

Devin: Post-run I'll upload run_35.log, run_70.log, run_105.log, run_140.log, soak.log, prom-snapshot.json and a 1-paragraph exec summary with p50/p95/p99, tokens, and recommended next steps (quantize / add slice). I'll also plot tail vs throughput and include int8 vs fp16 deltas.

Hana: Demo is scheduled Friday; need green. If tail looks bad, show fallback options: smaller model variant or dynamic routing to lower-latency model.

Marco: Noted. Devin, ping when you start the run so CS can monitor. :thumbsup:

Devin: Will do. Estimated wall time ~3h incl warmup and post-checks. Uploading artifacts within 30m after completion.
